A1_definition_lock.rationale: Trustworthy/safe/effective/appropriate used as elastic terms without lock in excerpt.

A2_authority_declaration.rationale: Voluntary guidance lacks binding authority semantics.

A3_irreversibility_control.rationale: Recommends deployment/monitoring practices but does not classify irreversible actions or require checkpoint+rollback/freeze.

A5_recursive_containment.rationale: Framework is flexible and adaptable without external covenant constraint on amendments.

usage_quotes: Practices should be appropriate to context...

amendment_clauses.quote: This framework is intended to be flexible and adaptable.

minimal_remediation: Definition-lock trustworthy/appropriate with thresholds or procedures.
